title: Answer a client's PING through the agent
description: Implements decision mimid-1wgh.132. A registered session's PING is answered only after the connection task has held the agent lock, so a PONG says the agent could have taken the user's next message. Unregistered connections keep the plain answer. Touches crates/mimid-agent-irc/src/command.rs, the front end's Limitations, docs/design/agent-frontends.md 4 and docs/irc-lessons.md Keepalive.
close_reason: Commit 32c72375: the IRC PONG holds the agent lock, both EventSource pings go through the store or the agent (decision mimid-1wgh.132).
